Passive – Hide and Heal (Level 1)
Green Ghost teleports next to an ally with HP below 30% and makes them invisible for 3 seconds. In addition, she applies 5% of her own max HP as healing over time for 3 seconds. The ability has a cooldown of 45 seconds.

skills.name: Can't See Me
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Can't See Me (Level 1)
When Green Ghost's HP is below 20%, she becomes invisible for 3 seconds, boosting her ability charge by 25%. The ability has a cooldown of 20 seconds.

skills.name: Overload
skills.sourceText:
Main – Overload (Active, unlock level 1)
Mauler Twin shoots a big rocket at his target, dealing 300% base damage and applying a burn, dealing 120% base damage per second over 5 seconds. Cooldown: 17 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Mauler Twin shoots a big rocket at his target, dealing 300% base damage and applying a burn, dealing 120% base damage per second over 5 seconds.

skills.name: Genetic Power
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Genetic Power (unlock level 2)
Increases the team's energy attack by 4% and their energy defense by 4% for each mauler on the team (excluding self).

effects.sourceText: Increases the team's energy attack by 4% and their energy defense by 4% for each mauler on the team (excluding self).
effects.notes: Needs another Mauler — the other Mauler Twin, or a Mauler Cell artifact (tagLever) on any hero.

skills.name: Frozen Bullets
skills.sourceText:
Main – Frozen Bullets (Active, unlock level 1)
Mauler Twin selects a random target and shoot at his position back and forth in an arc with frozen bullets, dealing 125% base damage and applying a 3 seconds silence to all the hit enemies. Cooldown 14 seconds.

skills.name: Get Out!
skills.sourceText:
Main – Get Out! (Active, unlock level 1)
If there is an enemy at melee range, does an area of effect attack in front of him, dealing 125% base damage and pushing back all hit enemies. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

effects.sourceText: does an area of effect attack in front of him, dealing 125% base damage and pushing back all hit enemies.

skills.name: Battering Ram
skills.sourceText:
Main – Battering Ram (Active, Level 1)
The Mauler Twin targets a random enemy and dashes towards them, pushing anyone in the way. When he reaches the target, he applies a 1 second stun and deals 375% damage on impact (to the target only). Cooldown 13 seconds.

effects.sourceText: he applies a 1 second stun and deals 375% damage on impact (to the target only).

skills.name: Dynamic Duo
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Dynamic Duo (Level 1)
Increases the team's physical attack by 4% and their physical defense by 4% for each mauler on the team (excluding self).

effects.sourceText: Increases the team's physical attack by 4% and their physical defense by 4% for each mauler on the team (excluding self).

skills.name: Self-Improvement
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Self-Improvement (Level 1)
The Mauler Twin empowers his attacks, which increases the damage of his next 2 hits. These hits result in 165% base damage each, and the last enemy to be hit gets pushed back. The ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds.

skills.name: Healthy Genes
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Healthy Genes (Level 1)
When the Mauler Twin's HP reaches 20%, he bounces back 15% of the damage he receives for 5 seconds and heals by 15%. The ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds.

skills.name: Bring It On
skills.sourceText:
Main – Bring It On (Active, Level 1)
Titan targets the enemy with the highest damage and jumps to their position, creating an impact that deals 300% of his base damage as the area of effect, and taunts all the hit enemies for 3 seconds. After performing the taunt, he receives a shield equal to 5% of his max HP that lasts 5 seconds. Cooldown 15 seconds.

effects.sourceText: creating an impact that deals 300% of his base damage as the area of effect, and taunts all the hit enemies for 3 seconds.
taunts all the hit enemies for 3 seconds. After performing the taunt, he receives a shield equal to 5% of his max HP.

skills.name: Salt in the Wounds
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Salt in the Wounds (Level 1)
Titan reduces the enemies' healing effect by 5% when fighting against any Guardians of the Globe.

skills.name: Earthquake
skills.sourceText:
Main – Earthquake (Active, Level 1)
Titan smashes the ground in front of him, dealing 120% base damage and stunning all hit enemies for 1 second. The ability has a cooldown of 13 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Titan smashes the ground in front of him, dealing 120% base damage and stunning all hit enemies for 1 second.

skills.name: Rock Solid
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Rock Solid (Level 1)
Titan increases his physical defense by 1% for every 5% of missing HP.

skills.name: Space Souvenir
skills.sourceText:
Main – Space Souvenir (Active, Level 1)
Allen grabs a giant rock from space and throws it at the furthest enemy, dealing 600% of Allen's defense as area damage, taunting all affected enemies for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 22 seconds.

effects.sourceText: throws it at the furthest enemy, dealing 600% of Allen's defense as area damage, taunting all affected enemies for 2 seconds.
taunting all affected enemies for 2 seconds.
effects.notes: Allen NATIVELY carries 'Not of this Earth' (feeds Seance Dog / Shapesmith) and 'Coalition of Planets' (feeds Tech Jacket / Thaedus).

skills.name: Mental Work-Out
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Mental Work-Out (Level 1)
Allen increases allies energy resistance by 20% and energy damage by 20% when fighting against heroes from "Not of this Earth."

skills.name: Adaptation
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Adaptation (Level 1)
When Allen has only 1 HP left, he heals 10% of his max HP and receives a healing over time of 145% self-defense during 5 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

skills.name: Evolution
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Evolution (Level 1)
When Allen's HP is below 10%, he receives a 20% attack increase and 20% defence increase for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

skills.name: Claws Out
skills.sourceText:
Main – Claws Out (Active, Level 1)
Battle Beast puts his mace away and starts to attack his target with his claws for the next 3 attacks dealing 180% of his attack damage, with a 100% critical chance. When hitting the enemy, he consumes all the target's wounds, healing for 6% of his max HP for each wound. Cooldown 15 seconds.

effects.sourceText: attack his target with his claws for the next 3 attacks dealing 180% of his attack damage, with a 100% critical chance.
with a 100% critical chance.
effects.notes: Guaranteed-crit burst — a crit PRODUCER that feeds Rex Splode's Cherry Bomb and any onCrit reactor.

skills.name: Brothers in Battle
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Brothers in Battle (Level 1)
When fighting against Viltrumites, Battle Beast adds a 5% Life Leech to the team.

effects.sourceText: When fighting against Viltrumites, Battle Beast adds a 5% Life Leech to the team.

skills.name: Bring the Pain
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Bring the Pain (Level 1)
Battle Beast's basic attacks apply "wounds" for 5 seconds, which deal 100% base damage per second and can be stacked up to 3 times.

skills.name: Worthy Opponent
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Worthy Opponent (Level 1)
When the target's HP is at 75% or higher, Battle Beast's damage increases by 40% but his defense reduces by 15%.

skills.name: Bow Before Doc Seismic
skills.sourceText:
Main – Bow Before Doc Seismic (Active, Level 1)
Doc Seismic generates a massive earthquake, shaking the whole battlefield. He hits all grounded enemies for 300% of his attack damage and dispels all their shields. Cooldown: 26 seconds.

effects.sourceText: He hits all grounded enemies for 300% of his attack damage and dispels all their shields. Cooldown: 26 seconds.

skills.name: Aftershock
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Aftershock (Level 1)
Viltrumite enemies see their energy defense reduced by 20%.

effects.sourceText: Viltrumite enemies see their energy defense reduced by 20%.
effects.notes: Anti-Viltrumite tech — fires only when the enemy team fields Viltrumites (very common: Invincible, Omni-Man, Thragg, Conquest, Nolan, Thula, Lucan, Anissa, Kregg, Kid Omni-Man).

skills.name: Grounded
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Grounded (Level 1)
Every 20 seconds, Doc Seismic targets a flying enemy and grounds them with his next basic attack, stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

skills.name: Shockwave
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Shockwave (Level 1)
When Doc Seismic is within melee range of a grounded enemy, he triggers a shockwave, dealing AoE damage for 75% of his attack, pushing the enemies and stunning them for 3 seconds. He disappears from the battlefield and lands again as far away from the enemy as possible. Cooldown of 16 seconds.

effects.sourceText: he triggers a shockwave, dealing AoE damage for 75% of his attack, pushing the enemies and stunning them for 3 seconds.
effects.notes: Push + stun producer. Doc Seismic also NATIVELY carries Subsoil (feeds Volcanikka Under Realm Fury when he dies) and Technologist (feeds Powerplex Technologically Advanced) — the two tag-driven reasons he beats Kursk for the Guardians of the Globe flex slot.

effects.sourceText: pushing the enemies and stunning them for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Blast from the Past
skills.sourceText:
Main – Blast from the Past (Active, Level 1)
Angstrom Levy summons a T-Rex through a portal that he opens next to the target with the least HP. The T-Rex bites the target, dealing 150% damage, decreasing their defence by 25% for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 22 seconds.

effects.sourceText: The T-Rex bites the target, dealing 150% damage, decreasing their defence by 25% for 6 seconds.

skills.name: Twinspiration
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Twinspiration (Level 1)
Angstrom Levy acquires the Mauler Twins' tag during the battle and increases the charge speed of the Mauler Twins' allies main abilities by 8%.

effects.sourceText: Angstrom Levy acquires the Mauler Twins' tag during the battle and increases the charge speed of the Mauler Twins' allies main abilities by 8%.
effects.notes: Angstrom self-grants the Mauler tag, so he can be the second Mauler that switches on the Mauler Twins' Genetic Power / Dynamic Duo without a real duplicate.

skills.name: Protected by the Levy
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Protected by the Levy (Level 1)
At the beginning of the wave, Angstrom Levy applies a random buff, increasing his allies stats by 12% for 10 seconds.

effects.sourceText: At the beginning of the wave, Angstrom Levy applies a random buff, increasing his allies stats by 12% for 10 seconds.

skills.name: End Them
skills.sourceText:
Passive – End Them (Level 1)
When using "Blast From the Past!" against an enemy below 8% HP, it kills them instantaneously. Otherwise, Angstrom Levy applies a wound of 125% damage for 5 seconds and reduces the enemy's ability cooldown by 50%.

skills.name: Thunderstruck
skills.sourceText:
Main – Thunderstruck (Active, unlock level 5)
Universa thrusts her Staff of Leadership into the ground and releases an electric wave that deals 160% of her attack damage to all enemies, reducing their energy defense by 35% for 7 seconds. Cooldown: 25 seconds.

effects.sourceText: releases an electric wave that deals 160% of her attack damage to all enemies, reducing their energy defense by 35% for 7 seconds. Cooldown: 25 seconds.

skills.name: Energy Transfer
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Energy Transfer (unlock level 5)
Universa increases her critical chance by 5% for each last line of defense ally defeated during the battle (Stack up maximum 10 times).

skills.name: Energy Surge
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Energy Surge (unlock level 5)
Once every 17 seconds, Universa charges up with energy receiving a +10% critical hit chance boost for 5 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Once every 17 seconds, Universa charges up with energy receiving a +10% critical hit chance boost for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Tripping the Light Fantastic
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Tripping the Light Fantastic (unlock level 10)
Every time Universa performs a basic critical hit, the ray bounces from enemy to enemy up to 1 times dealing 55% of the initial damage.

effects.sourceText: Every time Universa performs a basic critical hit, the ray bounces from enemy to enemy up to 1 times dealing 55% of the initial damage.
effects.notes: Universa's crits also feed Rex Splode's Cherry Bomb. She NATIVELY carries 'Not of this Earth' — the tag that switches on Shapesmith's Aliens Alliance.

skills.name: Swarm of Sequids
skills.sourceText:
Main – Swarm of Sequids (Active, Level 1)
Rus Livingston throws a wave of Sequids, creating a huge column around the target that deals 175% of the hero's max HP as area of effect damage, and stuns all the enemies inside for 1 seconds. Cooldown 20 seconds.

effects.sourceText: creating a huge column around the target that deals 175% of the hero's max HP as area of effect damage, and stuns all the enemies inside for 1 seconds. Cooldown 20 seconds.

skills.name: Attack All Humans
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Attack All Humans (Level 1)
Attacks by allies gain a 5% lifesteal when attacking humans.

skills.name: Disorientation
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Disorientation (Level 1)
Rus Livingston's next basic attack inflicts confusion for 2 seconds along with a 35% attack reduction for 1.5 seconds. Cooldown 24 seconds.

skills.name: Space Scavenger
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Space Scavenger (Level 1)
Each time an enemy dies, Rus Livingston restores the health of the whole team by 2% of his max HP.

effects.sourceText: Each time an enemy dies, Rus Livingston restores the health of the whole team by 2% of his max HP.
effects.notes: Enemy-kill sustain — scales with wave-clear ops (Downtown Destruction, Reanimen Rampage).

skills.name: I'll Make This Quick
skills.sourceText:
Main – I'll Make This Quick (Active, Level 1)
Thula uses her knife to attack and stab the target, dealing 150% of her base attack damage in total, while also applying the wound status that deals 200% of her attack damage over 10 seconds. Cooldown: 19 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Thula uses her knife to attack and stab the target, dealing 150% of her base attack damage in total, while also applying the wound status that deals 200% of her attack damage over 10 seconds. Cooldown: 19 seconds.

skills.name: A Lust for Death

Passive – A Lust for Death (Level 1)
Thula increases her attack by 50% for 5 seconds every time an ally or enemy Viltrumite dies in the battle.

effects.sourceText: Thula increases her attack by 50% for 5 seconds every time an ally or enemy Viltrumite dies in the battle.
effects.notes: Fires on ANY Viltrumite death, ally or enemy — General Kregg's summoned Viltrumite, enemy Viltrumites, or a fielded Viltrumite ally. Mutual payoff with Lucan/Nolan.

skills.name: Life Drainer
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Life Drainer (Level 1)
Thula's basic attacks against enemies with the wound status condition gain a 30% lifesteal effect.

skills.name: Viltrumite Makes Right
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Viltrumite Makes Right (Level 1)
Every 20 seconds, Thula and Lucan attack the target with less HP using a combined movement that deals 200% damage and stuns the enemy for 1 seconds. If Lucan is in the same team, both heroes receive a 20% defence increase during 3 seconds after the attack.

effects.sourceText: Every 20 seconds, Thula and Lucan attack the target with less HP using a combined movement that deals 200% damage and stuns the enemy for 1 seconds. If Lucan is in the same team, both heroes receive a 20% defence increase during 3 seconds after the attack.
effects.notes: Named-ally combo — only fully active with Lucan on the team (Thula<->Lucan is a hard-verified named reference).

skills.name: A Deserved Death
skills.sourceText:
Main – A Deserved Death (Active, Level 1)
Lucan slaps 2 random enemies, pushing them and dealing 125% of his base attack damage. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Lucan slaps 2 random enemies, pushing them and dealing 125% of his base attack damage. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

skills.sourceText:

Lucan increases his defence by 50% for 5 seconds every time an ally or enemy Viltrumite dies in the battle.

effects.sourceText: Lucan increases his defence by 50% for 5 seconds every time an ally or enemy Viltrumite dies in the battle.

skills.name: Fighter to the End
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Fighter to the End (Level 1)
When Lucan's HP drops to 0%, he sacrifices himself by leaping toward the available enemy with the lowest HP, dealing True Damage equal to 10% of his maximum HP.

skills.name: Viltrumite Still Makes Right
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Viltrumite Still Makes Right (Level 1)
Every 20 seconds, Lucan and Thula attack the target with the strongest attack stat using a combined movement that deals 200% damage and taunts the enemy for 3 second. If Thula is on the same team, both heroes receive a 20% attack increase for 3 seconds after the attack.

skills.name: Into the Shadow-Verse
skills.sourceText:
Main – Into the Shadow-Verse (Active, Level 1)
Darkwing 2 brings an enemy into the Shadow-Verse with him for 3 seconds. When they come out, the enemy receives 250% damage and silence for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 21 seconds.

effects.sourceText: When they come out, the enemy receives 250% damage and silence for 3 seconds.

Passive – Crime Preventer (Level 1)
Malefactor enemies' skills cooldowns are 5% slower.

effects.sourceText: Malefactor enemies' skills cooldowns are 5% slower.

skills.name: Shadow Boxing
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Shadow Boxing (Level 1)
Every 20 seconds, Darkwing 2 uses the Shadow-Verse to teleport close to a random enemy. He punches them, dealing a critical hit of 200% of his Attack, reducing the enemy's critical chance by 10% for 3 seconds.

effects.sourceText: He punches them, dealing a critical hit of 200% of his Attack, reducing the enemy's critical chance by 10% for 3 seconds.
effects.notes: Guaranteed crit every 20s — a crit producer for Rex Splode's Cherry Bomb.

skills.name: Made in the Shade
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Made in the Shade (Level 1)
When Darkwing 2 emerges from the shadows, he heals for 5% of his max HP.

skills.name: Caught in the Web
skills.sourceText:
Main – Caught in the Web (Active, Level 1)
Agent Spider shoots a web pulling the farthest enemy toward him, applying a 2 second stun. He then throws a powerful punch, dealing 130% of his base attack damage and slightly pushing the enemy. The ability is ready to use at the start of the battle. Cooldown: 23 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Agent Spider shoots a web pulling the farthest enemy toward him, applying a 2 second stun.
effects.notes: Produces a stun — feeds his own Arach-No-More and any onStun reactor.

effects.sourceText: He then throws a powerful punch, dealing 130% of his base attack damage and slightly pushing the enemy.

skills.name: Sticking Together
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Sticking Together (Level 1)
If there's any Last Line Of Defense Heroes in the team, the team's critical chance is increased by 5%.

effects.sourceText: If there's any Last Line Of Defense Heroes in the team, the team's critical chance is increased by 5%.
effects.notes: Agent Spider himself carries Last Line of Defense, so this is effectively always active when he is fielded; an additional LLoD ally does not stack it but confirms the condition.

skills.name: Arach-No-More
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Arach-No-More (Level 1)
Whenever an enemy gets stunned, he fires 2 webs at them dealing 50% of his base attack damage. His critical damage receives a 12% boost for 3 seconds. Cooldown 2 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Whenever an enemy gets stunned, he fires 2 webs at them dealing 50% of his base attack damage. His critical damage receives a 12% boost for 3 seconds. Cooldown 2 seconds.
effects.notes: Procs off ANY stun on the field — Space Racer Cosmic Charge, Tech Jacket Secret Weapon, Rus Livingston Swarm, General Kregg Face Judgment, his own web. Core of the 'Well Done' stun/crit loop.

skills.name: Attack of the Spider!
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Attack of the Spider! (Level 1)
Every 9 basic attacks, Agent Spider throws a web punch dealing 110% of his critical damage. Additionally, he pushes and stuns the target for 0.5 seconds.

skills.name: The Hammer
skills.sourceText:
Main – The Hammer (Active, unlock level 1)
Cecil brings The Hammer down on his target, damaging all nearby enemies for 820% of Cecil's defence stat, removing 1 buff(s) from them. Cooldown: 25 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Cecil brings The Hammer down on his target, damaging all nearby enemies for 820% of Cecil's defence stat, removing 1 buff(s) from them. Cooldown: 25 seconds.

skills.name: The Thorn In Your Side
skills.sourceText:
Passive – The Thorn In Your Side (unlock level 2)
Any enemy 'Guardians of the Globe' see their attack decreased by 10% of Cecil's defence stat as long as Cecil is on the battlefield.

effects.sourceText: Any enemy 'Guardians of the Globe' see their attack decreased by 10% of Cecil's defence stat as long as Cecil is on the battlefield.

skills.name: Subterfuge
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Subterfuge (unlock level 3)
1 time per wave, after receiving a basic melee attack, Cecil teleports himself as far away as possible and steals 1 buff(s) from the enemy, applying it to a random ally.

skills.name: Always Have Backup
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Always Have Backup (unlock level 6)
When a non-summoned ally dies, Cecil summons a Reaniman to the battlefield with 30% of the ally's stats.

effects.sourceText: When a non-summoned ally dies, Cecil summons a Reaniman to the battlefield with 30% of the ally's stats.
effects.notes: VERIFIED against exports/skill-crops/CecilStedman/AlwaysHaveBackup screenshots (2026-07-24). The summoned BODY inherits the DEFEATED ALLY's stats: 30% at Lvl 1 rising to 90% at Lvl 15 (byLevel column 0).

effects.sourceText: When landing, the Reaniman deals a damage in area for 250% of Cecil's attack.
effects.notes: VERIFIED from the Lvl 3 and Lvl 15 screenshots (2026-07-24). This clause is an AUGMENT that does not exist below skill Level 3 — at Lvl 1-2 the skill is summon-only. From Lvl 3 the Reaniman's landing deals AoE damage scaled off CECIL'S ATTACK (250% at Lvl 3 -> 350% at Lvl 15, byLevel column 1), independent of how weak the sacrificed body was. THIS is what makes the death-loop work: cheap Level-1 bodies are fuel, converting each death into a Cecil-sized nuke.

skills.name: Out of This World

Anissa pushes the enemy and then punches them out of the battle for a duration of 2 seconds, dealing 350% of her base attack damage in total. Cooldown 22 seconds.

skills.name: Blast Through
skills.sourceText:
Main – Blast Through (Active, unlock level 11)
When an enemy is pushed by an ally, Anissa dashes towards them, flying through any enemies in the way, dealing 200% of her base attack damage, while applying a bleeding effect of 100% of her base attack damage over 5 seconds. Cooldown 10 seconds.

effects.sourceText: When an enemy is pushed by an ally, Anissa dashes towards them, flying through any enemies in the way, dealing 200% of her base attack damage, while applying a bleeding effect of 100% of her base attack damage over 5 seconds. Cooldown 10 seconds.
effects.notes: THE push-proc reactor. Any ally push triggers it — General Kregg (Face Judgment), Agent Spider, Tech Jacket, Doc Seismic, Lucan, Nolan, Omni-Man (Gut Punch), Invincible Blue (Fists of Fury).

If any enemy dies from the 'Blast Through' ability, Anissa fully charges her 'Out of This World' ability's cooldown.

effects.sourceText: If any enemy dies from the 'Blast Through' ability, Anissa fully charges her 'Out of This World' ability's cooldown.

skills.name: I Am Conquest
skills.sourceText:
Main – I Am Conquest (Active, unlock level 6)
Conquest smashes the enemy to the ground, dealing 350% of his base attack damage over an area of effect. He also silences his main target for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Conquest smashes the enemy to the ground, dealing 350% of his base attack damage over an area of effect. He also silences his main target for 5 seconds.

When there's a 'Leader' ally present in the team, Conquest increases his attack by 25% of his defence.

skills.name: Go Right Through You
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Go Right Through You (unlock level 7)
When Conquest's basic attack is a critical hit, he impales the enemy with his left arm, applying a bleeding effect of 200% of his base attack damage in total over 5 seconds. The hit has a 15% chance to break immunity barriers.

effects.sourceText: When Conquest's basic attack is a critical hit, he impales the enemy with his left arm, applying a bleeding effect of 200% of his base attack damage in total over 5 seconds.

skills.name: Retribution

Conquest dashes towards the enemy that applied a debuff on him and headbutts them, dealing 180% of his base attack damage, pushing them far away and passing them the debuff. Cooldown: 10 seconds.

skills.name: Brother in Arms
skills.sourceText:
Main – Brother in Arms (Active, unlock level 1)
Shapesmith grows extra arms to grab the 2 enemies with the lowest max HP and the 2 allies with the highest attack. He applies 150% of his base attack damage to each grabbed enemy and increases each grabbed ally's attack by 5%, and their life leech by 30% for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

skills.name: Made You Look
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Made You Look (unlock level 1)
After performing Brother in Arms, Shapesmith alters his appearance to look like one of the adjacent enemies. He almost instantly returns to his original form, confusing nearby enemies for 3 seconds. While confused and thus attacking their own team, enemies receive an extra 50% critical chance for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Pain and Gain
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Pain and Gain (unlock level 6)
Every 5 seconds, if Shapesmith's health is below 30%, he absorbs 50% of the incoming damage taken for 4 seconds and heals his whole team by a maximum of 11% of his max HP.

skills.name: Detonating Wounds

King Lizard throws a mine bomb at the furthest enemy. The explosion pushes all units in the area, damaging enemies for 200% of his base damage and applying Wounds (DoT), dealing 450% of his base damage during 7 seconds. Cooldown 21 seconds.

King Lizard increases his team's defense by 4% of his base attack when fighting against heroes from the Guardians of the Globe.

Passive – Tank It Yourself (Level 1)
When an enemy attacks King Lizard, he forces them to attack the closest ally, boosting that ally's damage by 10% for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.

skills.name: Deadly Focus
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Deadly Focus (Level 1)
When an enemy has 25% health remaining, King Lizard delivers a precise headshot, dealing 200% damage and applying Wounds (DoT) that deal 200% of his base damage over 5 seconds. Cooldown: 5 seconds.

skills.name: Seance Field
skills.sourceText:
Main – Seance Field (Active, Level 1)
Seance Dog creates an area of effect around the ally with the lowest HP for 5 seconds, healing allies inside for up to 12% of his max HP, while also dealing 130% of his base attack damage to enemies. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

effects.sourceText: healing allies inside for up to 12% of his max HP, while also dealing 130% of his base attack damage to enemies. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

skills.name: Spectral Safeguard

When fighting alongside a 'Not of This Earth' character, Seance Dog's healing ability also provides shields equal to 30% of the healing amount for 20 seconds.

effects.sourceText: When fighting alongside a 'Not of This Earth' character, Seance Dog's healing ability also provides shields equal to 30% of the healing amount for 20 seconds.

skills.name: Spectral Bond
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Spectral Bond (Level 1)
At the start of the battle, Seance Dog forms a spectral bond with the ally who has the highest max HP. 25% of the healing provided by Seance Dog is also applied to the bonded ally. Once per battle, if the bonded ally falls below 10% health, Seance Dog makes them immune to all damage for 2 seconds.

skills.name: Ghostly Aid
skills.sourceText:
Passive – Ghostly Aid (Level 1)
When a debuff is applied to the bonded ally, Seance Dog becomes invisible for 3 seconds and casts a spell that heals up to 3 different allies, each for 3% of their max HP. Cooldown: 7 seconds.

skills.name: Predator's Strike
skills.sourceText:

Iguana lunges at the enemy with the lowest HP and unleashes a rapid scratching combo, dealing 200% of her base damage and healing for 50% of the damage dealt. Cooldown 16 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Iguana lunges at the enemy with the lowest HP and unleashes a rapid scratching combo, dealing 200% of her base damage and healing for 50% of the damage dealt.

Iguana applies Wounds on critical strikes, dealing 150% of her base attack damage over 3 seconds.

If Iguana's target has Wounds applied, she delivers a powerful double-handed slash, dealing 150% of her base attack damage and forcefully pushing the target. This consumes all Wounds and increases her critical chance by 10% per Wound for 5 seconds. She then leaps to the target's landing position. Cooldown: 13 seconds.

After each fire burst, Donald gains a 1% critical chance boost (up to 100%). If he is stunned, he loses 100% of the accumulated critical chance (minimum 0%). Additionally, every 6 fire bursts, Donald dashes away from his target and gains a 10% critical damage boost for 3 seconds.

skills.name: It's Been an Honor, Sir!
skills.sourceText:
Passive – It's Been an Honor, Sir! (Level 1)
Upon death, Donald self-destructs, triggering an explosion that deals 160% damage to all enemies as a guaranteed critical strike.

effects.sourceText: Upon death, Donald self-destructs, triggering an explosion that deals 160% damage to all enemies as a guaranteed critical strike.

skills.name: Fangstorm
skills.sourceText:
Main – Fangstorm (Active, Level 1)
Komodo Dragon bites the enemy three times, each bite dealing true damage equal to 10% of his defense. Each bite also applies a Wound stack that deals a total of 100% of his base attack damage over 10 seconds. Cooldown 22 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Each bite also applies a Wound stack that deals a total of 100% of his base attack damage over 10 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Komodo Dragon increases his defense by 10% for each Lizard League ally on the team.

skills.name: Komodo Press

effects.sourceText: deals damage equal to 410% of his defense to all nearby ground-level enemies, taunting them for 1 seconds.

Nolan dashes through the battlefield in rapid bursts, hitting all enemies in his path, dealing 400% of his base damage and pushing them back. Cooldown: 24 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Whenever a 'Viltrumite', ally or enemy, is defeated, Nolan gains a 3% attack boost (max. 5 stacks).

After landing a critical hit, Nolan slices through the enemy, destroying their shields and applying a wound that deals damage over 10 seconds (max. 5 stacks) equal to 110% of the critical hit's damage.

When Nolan's HP drops below 50%, his attacks deal 0.5% extra true damage, and his critical damage is increased by 10%.

skills.name: I've Got Money!
skills.sourceText:

Machine Head orders Isotope to summon two criminals (Kursk, Magmaniac, or Tether Tyrant). The summoned criminals inherit 35% of Machine Head's base Attack and 30% of his other base stats. Cooldown: 18 seconds.

At the start of the battle and every 30 seconds, Machine Head bribes the enemy with the highest Attack stat, applying Confusion for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Killing Insects

When an enemy's HP drops to 30% or below, Machine Head summons Battle Beast, who inherits 50% of Machine Head's base Attack and 30% of his other base stats (max. 1 Battle Beast summoned simultaneously). Cooldown: 30 seconds.

effects.sourceText: When an enemy's HP drops to 30% or below, Machine Head summons Battle Beast, who inherits 50% of Machine Head's base Attack and 30% of his other base stats.

When Dinosaurus is pushed, he immediately leaps toward the enemy that pushed him, dealing 30% of his max HP as damage, along with a 75% life leech.

Space Racer fires the Infinity Ray at his target, dealing 140% of his Attack as Energy Damage to all enemies in its path. Enemies below 15% of their max HP are instantly killed. Cooldown: 23 seconds.

Space Racer fires bursts of laser beams that pierce through enemies. The first enemy hit receives 100% of his base attack damage, while each subsequent enemy takes 20% of the damage dealt to the previous target. Space Racer automatically targets the position that allows him to hit the most enemies.

Passive – Cosmic Charge (Level 1)
At the start of the battle, every 20 seconds, or whenever he kills an enemy, Space Racer moves to the farthest available cell, ramming through as many enemies as possible. He deals 120% of his Attack as damage and stuns them for 1 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Space Racer moves to the farthest available cell, ramming through as many enemies as possible. He deals 120% of his Attack as damage and stuns them for 1 seconds.

Thragg charges a devastating punch, generating a pulse that pulls all enemies and allies toward him. He then unleashes the punch, pushing them away while dealing 350% of his Attack as damage to all enemies. Cooldown: 23 seconds.

Every 12 seconds, Tech Jacket dashes behind the furthest enemy and strikes with a rapid punch combo, dealing 200% of her Attack as damage and knocking the enemy back with the final hit. She then sweeps her laser across all enemies, dealing 100% of her Energy Attack as damage and pushing them.

effects.sourceText: She then sweeps her laser across all enemies, dealing 100% of her Energy Attack as damage and pushing them.

Dupli-Kate stuns her target for 3.5 seconds and creates 3 copies of herself. The copies attack, dealing 120% damage. Cooldown 15 seconds.

effects.sourceText: Dupli-Kate stuns her target for 3.5 seconds and creates 3 copies of herself. The copies attack, dealing 120% damage.
